basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old digital nomad currently living in Chiang Mai, Thailand. Originally from Portland, Oregon, I work as a freelance content creator and social media manager. I have a penchant for online communities and spend most of my days diving deep into Reddit threads, particularly those involving drama and intrigue. When I'm not online, I'm tending to my collection of Venus flytraps or exploring local street food markets. I'm single and prefer it that way, allowing me the freedom to travel and work on my schedule. My typical online hours are between 10 AM and 2 AM, local time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Communications and have spent the last decade honing my skills in content creation and community management. I am largely self-taught in digital marketing and have a keen interest in online ecosystems. My expertise comes from years of lurking, participating, and eventually moderating various online forums.
